summary: The implementation successfully delivers most core requirements including transaction types, pan-India location support, project stage categorization, admin approval workflow, news section, QubeYards currency system, partner role restrictions, and premium branding with teal/gold design. However, some specific acceptance criteria are partially implemented or lack complete evidence in the diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Only admins can edit any property details
missing_requirements.reason: While admin approval is implemented, there is no evidence of an admin-only property edit function in the backend or frontend

missing_requirements.requirement: Property submitters can see their pending submissions
missing_requirements.reason: The PropertyList filters properties but no evidence shows filtering to display only the caller's own pending submissions

missing_requirements.requirement: Currency transactions are logged with timestamps and reasons
missing_requirements.reason: The backend tracks QubeYards balance but there is no evidence of a transaction log structure with timestamps and reasons for each transaction

missing_requirements.requirement: Recent currency transactions are listed with details
missing_requirements.reason: CurrencyBalanceCard displays the balance but does not show a list of recent transactions with details
